notes: Synthetic dataset. Метрики отражают поведение модели на синтетике, не на реальных данных Avito.

logistic_regression.reason: Go-native inference already implemented and tested; CatBoost gain on synthetic 60-intern data is 0.005 NDCG@5 (within noise); CatBoost JSON tree inference in Go is substantial engineering work not justified for this gain.

catboost_classifier.reason: Highest NDCG@5 in v2 experiment (0.6266 vs LR 0.6212); ready to deploy when Go-native tree inference is implemented or when real data warrants the upgrade.
